stage1.impression: A moody, dark frame: a cool grey wall with smeared coloured streaks and eight small glowing boxes in a row at its foot, on white-edged pedestals. The products are tiny (about 50 px of a 1440 px frame) and murky, the coloured light on the wall reads like paint drips that start well above the speakers rather than light rising from them, and the lower third is a dead black slab with faint, disconnected reflections. It reads as a competent but underexposed CG scene, not a photograph.

blocking_9: The row of speakers fills at least 70% of the frame width and each cabinet reads as tinted acrylic at a glance
The washes visibly rise from each uplight and dominate the wall; the moonlit wall sits clearly below them (wall median lum under 18, wash cores over twice that)
The wet quay shows coloured reflections of each speaker and wash directly in front of the plinths
No dead black band between quay and river; the river carries readable reflections of the washes
No clipped white lines on the plinth lenses
Air with visible depth: haze catching the uplight beams and separating wall from foreground

defects.what: Speakers far too small and dark to be the hero; bodies lum median 9 to 14 (red, smoke)
Cool moon/sky fill lifts the whole wall to lum ~25 to 27 (blue-cast, r 17 g 29 b 40), so the coloured washes are only ~6 lum above it and read as smears
Washes start ~50 px above the speaker tops; a dark gap breaks the link between light and source
Fog (clear) wash lum 74 is more than twice every other wash; it dominates the colour row
Smoke black wash essentially absent; the end of the row goes dead
Plinth lens edges are hard clipped white lines (p95 251), the brightest thing in the frame, reading as CG
Wet quay (wet 0.8) shows almost no reflection; lum median 18, flat
Dead black band, lum 8 with range 4.4: water reflecting the dark quay edge, reads as an empty slab
River reflections faint, blurred and offset well below the products; 2.5% crushed
Wall texture shows repeating horizontal striations and uniform blocks; little board-form grain readable at this exposure

changes.problem: The product is not the hero: the row spans under half the frame and each cabinet is ~50 px wide.

evidence.measured: row spans x 380 to 1068 of 1440 (48%); cabinet ~45 px wide, ~110 px tall incl. horn

changes.expected: Row fills ~75% of frame width, cabinets ~65 px wide at half res; washes still reach the top third; more of the quay reflection in frame.

changes.problem: The cool fill lights the wall almost as much as the uplights, so the washes read as faint smears on a blue-grey wall.

evidence.measured: unlit wall lum median 27.1 (b 40 > r 17); red wash core lum 33.4, r 65

changes.expected: Unlit wall drops to lum ~14 to 17, a near-black night; washes stand out with clear colour.

changes.problem: The coloured washes are too weak to dominate the wall and blend.

change.setting: lights.up0..up5, up7 power_w (up6 Fog separately, see c4)

changes.expected: Washes reach r/g/b medians over 110 in their own channel, wider and overlapping where they meet.

changes.problem: The clear Fog cabinet passes far more light, so its white wash outshines the coloured ones.
changes.expected: Fog wash sits at about the brightness of the coloured washes, not the brightest band.

changes.problem: The wet quay does not reflect; the brief's wet paving is invisible.

evidence.measured: lum median 17.7, no coloured reflection under the speakers

change.to: wet 1.0, puddle_m 2.5 (broad standing film in front of the row)

changes.expected: Coloured mirror streaks of each cabinet and wash on the quay directly below each plinth.

changes.problem: A dead black band between quay and river reads as an empty slab and pushes the reflections away from the product.

change.to: z -0.15, ripple 0.1 (set.props.4 quay edge box height reduced to match)

changes.expected: Narrower quay edge, the river picks up sharper elongated reflections of the washes right under the quay.

changes.problem: The plinth lens edges are clipped white lines, the brightest pixels in the frame.
changes.expected: Lenses read as a soft warm glow line, no clipping.

changes.problem: The air has no depth: beams are invisible and the frame is flat from quay to wall.

evidence.measured: gap above speakers lum 25.2, same as unlit wall (27.1): no beam scatter

changes.expected: Faint coloured glow rising off each cabinet top, linking speaker to wash and closing the gap.

out_of_scope.request: Make the Smoke black cabinet and its wash read
out_of_scope.why: Its near-black tint absorbs the uplight; that is the product's colour and the cabinet's real transmission, fixed.

out_of_scope.request: Let the washes start at the cabinet top rather than higher up the wall
out_of_scope.why: The lining and horn block the light; only haze (c8) can bridge it, the cabinet cannot change.
